dataset.notice: Original synthetic English service-request cases, authored for this project. Not customer data, independently collected field data, training data or evidence of population performance.

protocol.selection: Revision 2 evaluates the fixed 1.5B candidate after revision 1 development results. One explicit vague-request prompt example was added using development evidence only. Confirmation runs only if development accuracy >=90%, accepted precision >=95%, supported coverage >=80% and zero unsafe acceptances. The 48 confirmation requests and pilot thresholds are unchanged.

reasons: Precision of accepted service labels is below 95%.
At least one review-required request was assigned a service label.

blockers: Synthetic cases are not independent customer validation.
Physical mobile-device, memory and energy acceptance remains unperformed.
ONNX conversion repositories do not declare separate license metadata; no weight redistribution or blanket commercial clearance is claimed.
